findings.message: The error from json.Unmarshal is ignored, so a malformed or wrongly shaped body (for example an object instead of an array) imports nothing and still returns 204 No Content. Clients get no signal that their import was rejected.
io.ReadAll reads the entire request body with no size limit. A client can exhaust server memory with one large request.
Widgets are created one by one with no transaction. If one Create fails partway through, the earlier widgets stay persisted while the client gets a 500. A retry then creates duplicates.
